description: clam: box model shaped like a real clam (rounded fan outline from 1-unit rows, domed valves from a full seam layer + an inset outer layer), full-block footprint, 3 units high: bottom valve 0..1.5, lid 1.5..3, hinge along the BACK (north) edge, opening faces south. State 'open': every lid element swings up 67.5 degrees about the hinge (front edge rises) showing the inside: nacre, purple edge, peach flesh. ONE atlas, uv in units of 8 px.
